purpose: Submit maintenance complaint successfully with complete required parameters.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/ with title='Broken light fixture', location='Library 2nd Floor', category='electrical', priority='medium'.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; status='draft'; complaint ID generated.

purpose: Submit maintenance complaint with missing title and location.
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; submission blocked with descriptive validation error.

purpose: Employee views and tracks status of existing complaints.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns array of user complaints with statuses.

purpose: Engineer assesses assigned complaint and advances ticket to under review.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status changes from 'submitted' to 'under_review'.

purpose: Engineer prepares and submits repair cost estimate and completion date.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; estimated cost and required_by updated successfully.

purpose: Flag work request as urgent priority.
action_or_input: Create or update request with priority='urgent'.
expected_result: Work request priority is set to 'urgent' and priority score reflects maximum urgency.

purpose: Supervisor reviews and approves low-cost estimate (< Rs. 25,000).
Supervisor rejects estimate with justification note.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/iwd/requests/{id}/reject/ with note='Estimate too high for minor repair'.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status='rejected'; note recorded in history.

purpose: Check stock levels and identify available inventory for repair.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns items with quantity_available and unit_cost.

purpose: Query inventory low-stock alerts to coordinate restocking.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns items where is_low_stock is true.

purpose: Manage contractor directory and view accredited vendors.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; returns list of active contractors with registration numbers.

purpose: Complete repair work and record actual cost.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status='completed'; completed_at timestamp set.

purpose: Close completed repair ticket following verification.
Examine complete transition audit trail for rejected ticket.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; logs show from_status, to_status='rejected', and rejection note.
